title: Heterogeneous quantization evaluation harness and cohort-specific fallback guardrails
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an eval harness and operational gating strategy to measure and mitigate quality regressions introduced by heterogeneous quantization profiles (AWQ, GPTQ, int8, int4) across multiple customer workloads. The goal is to: (1) quantify per-cohort quality delta vs fp16 baselines, (2) produce cohort-aware thresholds for automatic rollback/fallback, and (3) integrate signals into Console dashboards and rollout policies. This ticket covers dataset selection, metric design, threshold synthesis, and a first-pass automation prototype for canary gating and automatic fallback to fp16 or higher-bit fallback variants.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Eval harness can run AWQ and GPTQ variants and produce normalized deltas for at least 4 workload cohorts (chat, summarization, RAG-QA, classification). 2) For each cohort we compute at least three quality metrics (task-appropriate; e.g., Exact Match, MRR@10, ROUGE-L or normalized logprobs) and a combined regression score. 3) Thresholding algorithm outputs cohort-specific gates (percentile + delta) and stores them in the rollout config. 4) Canary experiment: deploy quantized model to 10% traffic for one week with automatic rollback when cohort regression score exceeds gate. 5) Metrics and alerts appear in runtime-1.22 console dashboard and a Datadog monitor is created. 6) Documentation and runbook added to Confluence with clear remediation steps.
test_plan: - Datasets: sample and holdout sets for chat (multi-turn customer support), summarization (news/long-doc), RAG-QA (open-domain retrieval), classification (intent). - Model variants: fp16 baseline, AWQ-int8, AWQ-int4, GPTQ-int8. - Metrics: normalized task metric (higher-is-better), token-level perplexity delta, latency p95, and failure cases count. - Run: full eval sweep per-cohort with 3 seeds for stochastic tasks. - Threshold synthesis: compute per-example delta, then cohort 90th and 95th percentiles; derive gate = max(absolute_threshold, relative_percentile). - Canary: route 10% live traffic, compute rolling 24h regression score; trigger rollback if score > gate for 6 consecutive windows.
progress_updates: 2026-02-23: Prototype harness implemented to run AWQ and GPTQ conversions from the model registry; initial conversion scripts in repo: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime-evals/pull/186.
2026-03-01: Dataset curation complete for chat and RAG-QA cohorts (5k examples each). Summarization and classification samples at 3k each. Baseline fp16 run done for chat and RAG-QA.
2026-03-05: First-pass metric combinator defined: weighted sum of normalized task metric (0.7) and perplexity inverse (0.3); experimented with different normalization schemes.

2026-03-09: Threshold synthesis experiments show AWQ-int8 median delta of 0.4% vs fp16 on RAG-QA but 95th percentile delta spikes to 3.2% on failure sub-cohort (long-context retrieval). Decided to add per-subcohort tagging for long-context drift.
2026-03-12: Implemented automated gate exporter that writes JSON rollout config and integration hook for Console; created Datadog monitor template (DD-MON-quant-reg-001).

regression_triggers: - 95th-percentile cohort delta > 2.5% absolute on normalized task metric. - Any cohort with MRR drop > 4% relative for RAG-QA. - Increase in hallucination proxy (semantic-similarity mismatch) by > 0.6 AU. - Token-level perplexity delta > 8% for summarization cohort.
operational_plan: 1) Run nightly batch evals on sampled workloads; publish results to Console and attach gating hints. 2) During rollout, evaluate canaries every 6 hours; if gate breached, immediately reduce traffic to 0% for quant variant and trigger an incident. 3) If regression is isolated to a subcohort, create a selective routing rule to exclude that cohort from quant path and keep routing others to quant variant. 4) Postmortem template and triage checklist added to Confluence.
risks_and_mitigations: - Risk: High variance for low-sample cohorts can cause false positives. Mitigation: use bootstrap confidence intervals and require sustained breaches across windows. - Risk: Quant conversion nondeterminism. Mitigation: run 3 seeds and use median. - Risk: Operational complexity of cohort routing. Mitigation: start with two cohorts for automatic gating (high-risk vs low-risk) and expand.
